ZONINGLOT DEVELOPMENT ANDEASEMENT AGREEMENT (Hereinafter the“Agreement") made as of this 22nd day of October,2014 between 250VARET REALTY INC., having an office at 90-46 Corona Avenue, Elmhurst, NY 11373(Hereinafter the "Grantor"), and 19 BOGART REALTY DEVELOPM ENT INC., having an office at 86-26 Queens Boulevard, 2FL, Elmhurst, NY 11373 (Hereinafter the “Developer"). RECITALS: WHEREAS, Grantor is the fee owner of certain land in the City of NewYork, County of Kings,State of NewYork, designated as Block 3118 Lot 14 on the Tax Map of the City of New York (Hereinafter the“Tax Map'),and by the street address 250Varet Street,Brooklyn,New York, and being more particularly described in Exhibit I annexed hereto (said premises being herein called “Parcel A,"' and any existing buildings and improvements located thereon being "Premises A"); and WHEREAS,Developeris thefee owner of certainlandlocated in the City of NewYork, County of Kings, State of New York, designated as Block 3118 Lot 19 (formerly Lots 22, 121,        s            being more particularly described in Exhibit II annexed hereto (said parcel of land being herein called “Parcel B' and any existing buildings and improvements located thereon being called the “Developer's Building" and said land, buildings and improvements being herein called "Premises B"); and WHEREAS, Developer intends to construct a new building (Hereinafter the “New Building") on Parcel B which will contain or use more zoning floor area and development rights than are now available under the Zoning Resolution if the Parcel B is an independent zoning lot; and WHEREAS, the parties hereto desire to utilize the procedure available pursuant to the Zoning Resolution (as herein defined) for combining Parcel A and Parcel B into one single appurtenant to Parcel A and Grantor is willing to transfer the Excess Development Rights associated with·Parcel A to Parcel B in perpetuity; and WHEREAS, the parties hereto executed a Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions (Hereinafterthe“Declaration")in accordancewithSection12-10'oftheZoningResolution in A and Parcel B, which Declaration is dated April 18, 2011 and recorded on April 20, 2011 under CRFN: 2011000151184 in the Office of the City Register of the City of New York; and rights and obligations in and to the Combined Zoning Lot and other matters. 1

NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the promises and covenants hereinafter contained, the parties hereto covenant and agree as follows: 1. Asusedherein: (a) “"Zoning Resolution" shall mean The Zoning Resolution of the City of New York (Hereinafter the “City"), effective as of December 15, 1961, as amended from time to time. (④) “"City Agencies" shall mean and refer to the City Planning Commission, Department of CityPlanningof the City of NewYork,the City Council,theNewYorkCity Landmarks Preservation Commission, the local Community Board, the Manhattan Borough President and any other relevant or necessary city agencies, or any successor entity to any of the foregoing. (c) “Excess Development Rights" shall mean those Floor Area Development Rights appurtenant lo Parcel A on the date hereof and/or on a future date, considered as if it were a separate zoning lot, in excess of Grantor's Utilized DevelopmentRights. (d) accordance with the Zoning Resolution, which are appurtenant to a zoning lot, to develop such zoninglot by erecting thereon a structure or structures with a total floor areadetermined by (i) multiplying the area of the zoning lot by the basic maximum allowable floor area ratio for structures in the zoning district in which the zoning lot is located, and (i) by the inclusion of any available bonus floor area and any use, bulk, density and other development rights permitted under the Zoning Resolution and which may be authorized to be developed by any City Agencies. (e) and “Bulk" shall have the meaning set forth in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution. "Grantor's Utilized Development Rights"shall mean the total square feet of Floor Area Development Rights utilized by Grantor's Building as of the date hereof, pursuant to the building plans of the Grantor's Building approved by and filed with the Department of Buildings oftheCityofNewYork. 2. over a portion of Parcel A, except for the air space currently occupied by Grantor's Building and any existing appurtenances thereto (including bulkheads), as it and they exist on the date hereof or other improvements on Parcel A, including any addition to or extension of Grantor's Building, shall at any time hereafter be constructed or allowed to exist, and no reconstruction, replacement, alteration, repair or rebuilding (each, a “Rebuilding") of Grantor's Building or any existing appurtenances thereto (including bulkheads), whether following a casualty or otherwise, shall have a total floor area or bulk in excess of Grantor's Utilized Development Rights. 2
